name: Pelatiah and the princes at the east gate
charge: Devising mischief and giving wicked counsel in the city
summary: In vision Ezekiel saw twenty-five men at the east gate of the temple, princes of the people, Jaazaniah and Pelatiah among them, who said, it is not near; let us build houses: this city is the caldron, and we be the flesh. He was told to prophesy against them.
offense: Rulers who reassured the city against the prophets, treating Jerusalem as a safe pot for its own meat, while multiplying slain in its streets. The Lord: ye have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen.
judgment: As Ezekiel prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. The prophet fell on his face and cried out, wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?
